intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap of 10000 city/network means; six equal family means for power.
curve_convention: Exact piecewise-constant fractions between every decision boundary; endpoint ties have zero integration measure. Coincident curves are not displaced.
power_loss: lambda * unsafe + conservative, family-weighted and uniformly integrated over the target band; no real accident-cost interpretation.
nonbacktracking: Leading spectral onset used as a graph-aware screening comparator; it does not target the same finite maximum-slope diagnostic.
